analyst.text: New Orleans are a trade-market story: Dejounte Murray requested a trade on Nov 13 (and is out injured), and teams are asking about Zion Williamson, Trey Murphy III and Herb Jones. Zion (thigh) and Murphy are listed probable after leaving the San Antonio loss early. Phoenix have won three straight; the unsettled Pelicans locker room leans this towards Phoenix.
